content.title: A new update is available!
content.title_vi: Đã có bản cập nhật mới!
content.title_fr: Une nouvelle mise à jour est disponible !
content.title_ja: 新しいアップデートが利用可能です！
content.message:
- Floating Bubble: Quick-access popup anywhere; optimized permission setup.
- Rampager Studio: Added latest skins & fixed asset downloads.
- New Weapon: Ashbite Dagger.
- Weapon Stats: Added Explosion Range, Pierce Area Damage & Persist Projectiles.
- About Section: Added author info & project milestones.
- UI: Improved layout & stat comparison responsiveness.
- Bug Fixes: Fixed rounding for Speed and Jump stats.

- Corrección de errores: Corregido redondeo en Speed y Jump.
